program.name: Density Supersets
program.subject: Strength
program.blurb: Six lifts in three supersets, upper and lower days, more work in the same half hour.
program.about: More work packed into the same time. Each day is three supersets, two lifts back to back with one rest after both, so the half hour holds six exercises. Upper and lower days alternate. Abs finish every session. Level II slows the lowering to three seconds and Level III moves you one weight up.
